payload.title: Employee.farmId is a writable GraphQL field on create and update, validated only as a UUID, never checked against the site registry and never approved by HR, and the EmployeeCreated and EmployeeUpdated event contracts declare it although no producer ever fills it
evidence: apps/hr-service/src/hr/dto/update-employee.input.ts:9-11 (the update input inherits farmId from the create input)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/handlers/create-employee.handler.ts:44-49 (only the department is validated; farmId is stored unchecked)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/entities/employee.entity.ts:277-279 (Employee.farmId is a GraphQL output field and a column)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/events/hr.events.ts:26-36 (the EmployeeCreated factory never sets farmId; 53-62 does the same for EmployeeUpdated)
payload.rule_violated: D5 says module duty is requested by managers and approved by HR, and ADR 052 makes the farm-service registry the owner of sites, so a site link must not be a free, unvalidated employee attribute.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-29, release R10.
